summary.text: Jenny Callison is a candidate with no party preference for California State Assembly District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrat Lori Wilson.
A U.S. Army veteran, she worked for the California Legislature for more than fourteen years, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Callison was born in California and served in the U.S. Army from 2002 to 2006, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was a PATRIOT missile launching station operator and maintainer.

She earned an associate degree from Solano Community College in 2009 and a bachelor's degree from California State University, Sacramento, in 2011, and she returned to Sacramento State to earn a graduate degree in 2021.

Callison said in the survey that a 2011 internship at the State Capitol became a career of more than fourteen years working for the Legislature, most recently as Chief Consultant to the Senate Military and Veterans Affairs Committee.
She ran for Assembly District 11 in 2022 as an independent and lost the general election to Wilson, 59.2 percent to 40.8 percent.
In the survey, Callison said she is a mother of two and that she coached Junior Giants baseball for nine seasons.
She said she would work to lower the cost of living and reduce state spending, and to streamline permitting and reduce fees to build more housing.
